abilities.description: Can read service panels and valve maps well enough to identify likely failures and explain their consequences to non-specialists.
abilities.name: Systems diagnosis

abilities.description: Finds workable terms among divided council members, though she struggles when a proposal requires visible compromise.
abilities.name: Coalition building

characters.arc: Mara begins convinced that any reconnection will undermine the ring's claim to independence. When the repeating rhythm points toward a problem in shared machinery and the ring's reserves begin to tighten, she must choose whether to disclose the listeners' evidence to the Shipwardens. She opens a narrowly monitored route to the Core Exchange and submits the water ledger to joint review, ending with a practical charter proposal that treats cooperation as something the ring can choose rather than surrender.
characters.description: Mara Vey is the Seventh Ring Council's elected systems negotiator, raised among the habitat's communal gardens and workshops. She helped draft the independence declaration after shipwide authorities reassigned the ring's water without a council vote. Compact and sharp-eyed, with close-cropped dark hair and a pale line across one knuckle from years of valve work, she dresses plainly and keeps a grease-marked copy of the founding charter in her pocket. She wants the ring to govern itself, but knows isolation can turn a principled claim into a shared failure of life support.
characters.external_conflict: Council hardliners oppose reopening any route, while the Shipwardens demand access to shared systems and the ring's water allocation records.
characters.flaw: She treats compromise as a dangerous precedent and delays decisions until every concession can be defended as temporary.
characters.goal: Negotiate a limited maintenance corridor to the Core Exchange while keeping the council's independence declaration in force.
characters.internal_conflict: Mara believes self-rule is meaningless without control, yet fears that insisting on control at any cost will endanger the people she represents.
characters.motivation: Protect the ring's right to make decisions affecting its people without abandoning the shipwide cooperation their survival depends on.
characters.name: Mara Vey

abilities.description: Experienced in tracing faults through heat exchangers, circulation pumps, and shared maintenance systems.
abilities.name: Life-support engineering

abilities.description: Can organize crews and prioritize urgent repairs under pressure, but tends to centralize decisions.
abilities.name: Crisis command

characters.arc: Ilan begins by treating the severed lifts as proof that the council cannot be trusted with shared systems. When the listeners' rhythm leads him to evidence of a possible fault near the Core Exchange, he must decide whether to let Mara's team enter under agreed safeguards or force access and risk worsening the crisis. He accepts a jointly monitored maintenance corridor, ending as an accountable partner rather than the unquestioned commander he set out to be.
characters.description: Ilan Ro is a senior Shipwarden responsible for coordinating life-support maintenance across the inhabited tiers. He grew up in the shared machinery levels, where a missed inspection could put distant neighborhoods at risk, and came to believe that central oversight was the only reliable defense against local neglect. Broad-shouldered and prematurely gray, he wears a patched work coat with an old maintenance insignia and carries a small notebook of pump readings. He is not indifferent to the Seventh Ring's grievance, but sees its severed controls as a threat that cannot be allowed to become precedent.
characters.external_conflict: Mara's council refuses shipwide control, and the Rib Listeners' unexplained rhythm may expose a machinery problem that neither authority can safely investigate alone.
characters.flaw: He assumes that being accountable for a system gives him the right to command everyone who depends on it.
characters.goal: Restore Shipwarden access to the Core Exchange and secure inspection rights over the isolated ring's maintenance controls.
characters.internal_conflict: Ilan knows the charter gave each ring a voice, but fears that honoring that promise without enforceable oversight will repeat the near-disaster that shaped the founding compromise.
characters.motivation: Keep the ship's shared life-support systems reliable and prevent a local dispute from putting other rings at risk.
characters.name: Ilan Ro

abilities.description: Can distinguish deliberate repeating patterns from familiar pump and bearing vibrations by listening through the ship's structural ribs.
abilities.name: Vibration reading

abilities.description: Knows how to move through narrow maintenance crawls and recognize which panels provide safe access.
abilities.name: Service-route navigation

characters.arc: Seli begins by keeping the full rhythm pattern within the listeners' network until she can confirm its meaning. When the authorities prepare to seal access around the Crown Lift Junction, she chooses to demonstrate the sequence to both sides and identifies which parts are observation and which remain uncertain. Her disclosure helps secure a monitored investigation, and she ends willing to risk being challenged rather than letting fear of imperfection keep the evidence hidden.
characters.description: Seli Nam is a technician and courier in the loose network known as the Rib Listeners. Apprenticed to ship mechanics, she learned to distinguish pump chatter and bearing strain by placing her ear against structural ribs, then helped map the repeating sequence that does not match known machinery. Small and restless, with copper wire wound around one wrist and a battered listening cup in her kit, she travels between the contested Crown Lift Junction and service access near the Core Exchange. Both authorities distrust her claims, and she has learned to treat secrecy as protection.
characters.external_conflict: The council and Shipwardens both want the rhythm contained, while the source appears to lie beyond a contested route to the shared machinery.
characters.flaw: She withholds uncertain evidence until she can prove every detail, even when delay gives powerful people time to control the story.
characters.goal: Convince Mara and Ilan to let a listener team verify the signal's source through a safe maintenance route.
characters.internal_conflict: Seli wants the listeners to be believed, but fears that publishing an incomplete interpretation will discredit them and endanger the people who helped her listen.
characters.motivation: Make sure the unusual rhythm is investigated before a hidden fault or compartment becomes impossible to reach.
characters.name: Seli Nam

abilities.description: Tracks water reserves, neighborhood distribution, and valve changes across the ring with careful, auditable records.
abilities.name: Allocation accounting

abilities.description: Can interpret the cistern control maps and identify which manual adjustments affect each neighborhood.
abilities.name: Manual valve mapping

characters.arc: Tomas begins convinced that publishing every figure is the surest path to fair rationing. When a proposed disclosure would expose the technicians' protected reserve and the people maintaining the ring's filters, he must decide whether to release raw records or explain them alongside safeguards. He presents a verified allocation summary with the reserve's purpose and review process to both Mara and the Shipwardens, ending with a more responsible standard of transparency that does not confuse openness with abandoning people to pressure.
characters.description: Tomas Kel is the council's water ledger keeper, responsible for recording cistern reserves, neighborhood allocations, and manual valve changes in Water Ledger Hall. He joined the clerical service after his neighborhood suffered under an earlier opaque rationing decision, and he believes public records are the only defense against favoritism. Lean and careful, with ink-stained fingertips and a repaired collar, he is more comfortable with maps and figures than speeches. His records include the technicians' protected reserve as well as the council's contested distribution choices.
characters.external_conflict: The ring's reserves cannot sustain every neighborhood at its current rate, and the Shipwardens demand access to allocation records that the council wants to control.
characters.flaw: He trusts complete records more than human judgment and can mistake disclosure for fairness even when it exposes vulnerable people.
characters.goal: Publish a ration plan that preserves enough clean water for neighborhoods while protecting the technicians needed to maintain the ring's filters and circulation.
characters.internal_conflict: Tomas believes everyone deserves to see how water is allocated, but fears that revealing the protected reserve will make technicians targets for anger or political pressure.
characters.motivation: Keep water allocations fair and make decisions traceable to the people who live with their consequences.
characters.name: Tomas Kel

relationships.description: Mara Vey and Ilan Ro are opposing negotiators over the severed lifts: she fears his oversight will erase the ring's self-rule, while he fears her refusal will put shared life support at risk.
Ilan Ro doubts Seli Nam's interpretation of the unexplained rhythm and wants its investigation contained; Seli sees his caution as a way to keep Shipwarden control over the evidence.
Seli Nam relies on Mara Vey to secure access for investigating the rhythm, while Mara worries that Seli's uncertain evidence could undermine the council's negotiating position.
Tomas Kel advises Mara Vey on water allocation, but challenges her when political caution keeps the council from explaining its rationing decisions to the ring's residents.
